# Become a Quoter

Set up a UniswapX quoter on Ethereum mainnet, meet performance requirements, and move from beta to production.

Integrate as a quoter on UniswapX to compete for exclusive filling rights on Ethereum mainnet. This page is intended for experienced DeFi teams that have run similar systems on other protocols.

To ensure a smooth swapping experience for traders, the set of quoters is vetted by Uniswap Labs. The quoting system may become fully permissionless in the future.

Once approved by Uniswap Labs, follow the instructions below to complete your integration.

## [Quoter Requirements](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/mainnet/become-a-quoter\#quoter-requirements)

To participate as a quoter, you must host a service that adheres to the UniswapX RFQ API schema and responds to requests with quotes. The RFQ participant who submits the most competitive quote for a given order receives exclusive rights to fill it using their Executor during the _Exclusivity Period_ of the auction.

## [Performance Expectations](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/mainnet/become-a-quoter\#performance-expectations)

To ensure a smooth experience for swappers and a fair auction process for quoters, participants are held to the following performance standards:

Respond to Every Quote Request Within 500ms

Your server must respond to every quote request within 500ms. The budget is the same on every chain.

If you cannot quote, return a `204` with an empty body.

Do not let quote requests time out. Endpoints that time out on a meaningful share of requests may be disabled at Uniswap Labs' discretion until the issue is fixed.

## [Handling Fades & the Circuit Breaker](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/mainnet/become-a-quoter\#handling-fades--the-circuit-breaker)

Quoters are expected to honor and execute the quotes they submit. If a quoter submits a winning quote but fails to fill the subsequent order, the "circuit breaker" will be triggered, temporarily disabling the quoter from receiving new requests.

Cooldown Time

The cooldown period starts at 15 minutes for the first fade and increases exponentially for consecutive fades. See the [source code](https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswapx-parameterization-api/blob/bf87dcc0066fa21b72255f7155f5fbd04a518594/lib/cron/fade-rate-v2.ts#L215) for cooldown calculation details.

For more details on what counts as a fade (and what doesn't), see the [fade mechanics FAQ](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/faq#fade-mechanics).

## [RFQ API Integration Details](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/mainnet/become-a-quoter\#rfq-api-integration-details)

To successfully receive and respond to UniswapX RFQ Quotes, you must have a publicly accessible endpoint that handles incoming quote requests according to the following schema:

### [Request schema](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/mainnet/become-a-quoter\#request-schema)

```
{
  "method": "POST",
  "headers": {
    "content-type": "application/json"
  },
  "data": {
    "requestId": "uuid",
    "tokenInChainId": 1,
    "tokenOutChainId": 1,
    "swapper": "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
    "tokenIn": "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48",
    "tokenOut": "0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2",
    "amount": "1000000",
    "type": "EXACT_INPUT",
    "protocol": "v1",
    "numOutputs": 1,
    "quoteId": "uuid"
  }
}
```

### [Response schema](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/mainnet/become-a-quoter\#response-schema)

If you can fulfill the quote request, your server should respond with status `200` and the following data:

```
{
  "chainId": 1,
  "amountIn": "1000000",
  "amountOut": "548123456789000000",
  "filler": "0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678",
  "requestId": "uuid",
  "swapper": "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  "tokenIn": "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48",
  "tokenOut": "0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2",
  "quoteId": "uuid"
}
```

A `204` with an empty body is the expected signal when you cannot or will not quote.

### [Schema when disabled due to circuit breaker](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/mainnet/become-a-quoter\#schema-when-disabled-due-to-circuit-breaker)

If you are an onboarded quoter who is currently disabled by the circuit breaker, your server will receive the following message on the same quote endpoint:

```
{
  "method": "POST",
  "headers": {
    "content-type": "application/json"
  },
  "data": {
    "blockUntilTimestamp": 1735689600
  }
}
```

## [Moving to Production](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/mainnet/become-a-quoter\#moving-to-production)

All new quoter instances start by being onboarded to the [Beta environment](https://beta.api.uniswap.org/v2/uniswapx/docs). There, at least **5 valid Exclusive RFQ fills** must be demonstrated before moving to production. The Beta environment serves valid mainnet orders that should be filled against production contracts but does not receive traffic from production interfaces.

### [Steps to move to production](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/uniswapx/filling/mainnet/become-a-quoter\#steps-to-move-to-production)

1. **Provide the quote server URL** to your Uniswap Labs contact along with the contract address used to fill. It is recommended to use the same quoting infrastructure intended for production.

2. **Begin sending quotes and orders to beta** via the [UniswapX CLI](https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswapx-tool?tab=readme-ov-file#simple-order-creation). Reach out to the Uniswap team to be added to the private GitHub.

The beta environment now requires a Uniswap API key on every request. Generate one at [developers.uniswap.org](https://developers.uniswap.org/) and add it to a `.env` file in the project root as `UNISWAP_API_KEY`. A private key is only needed for `submit` commands that sign the order; set it as `UNISWAP_PRIVATE_KEY` in `.env` or pass it at runtime with `--private-key`.

3. **Send hashes of 5 filled transactions** that demonstrate that the integration was able to fill during the exclusive period; specifically before [decayStartTime](https://github.com/Uniswap/UniswapX/blob/abd7a0b080148fc42ef7c86536d14de714eec4c7/src/lib/ExclusiveDutchOrderLib.sol#L12)


The Uniswap Labs team will review the 5 transactions to confirm they were successful exclusive fills. Once confirmed, the quoter setup will be promoted to production and will start receiving traffic.

Interested in becoming a quoter?

To get started, [fill out the quoter intake form](https://developers.uniswap.org/quoter). For questions about the onboarding process, reach out to [quoters@uniswap.org](mailto:quoters@uniswap.org).
